verdict: Ads are running, but leads aren't reaching you — being fixed now.
narrative: Google Ads delivered 16 conversions on $1,699 in spend this period, but none of those conversions are showing up as leads in your pipeline — the issue is in how calls and form fills are being received and recorded, not in the campaigns themselves. At the same time, your Google Business Profile engagement dropped 51.6% week-over-week, with the last several days showing no activity, pointing to a real softening in local search visibility that we are monitoring closely. Your spend pacing also ran unevenly across the period, with 11 days recording no activity at all; we are stabilizing that to ensure your budget works consistently day to day. The immediate priority is closing the intake gap so that every conversion the ads are already generating actually lands as a trackable lead for your team.
